name: Python 3 + Streamlit + ngrok
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit pyngrok; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: python -c "from pyngrok import ngrok; url = ngrok.connect(8501); print(f'🌐 Public ngrok URL: {url}'); import subprocess; subprocess.run(['streamlit', 'run', 'app.py', '--server.enableCORS', 'false', '--server.enableXsrfProtection', 'false'])"
